using System.Net;

namespace Jellyfin.Api.Networking;

/// <summary>
/// Defines the <see cref="INetworkManager"/> interface.
/// </summary>
public interface INetworkManager
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets a value indicating whether the server is configured to allow remote access.
    /// </summary>
    bool IsRemoteAccessAllowed { get; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets a value indicating whether the server is configured to allow remote access from the given IP address.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="ipAddress">The IP address to check.</param>
    /// <returns><c>true</c> if the server is configured to allow remote access from the given IP address; otherwise, <c>false</c>.</returns>
    RemoteAccessPolicyResult ShouldAllowServerAccess(IPAddress ipAddress);
}

using Jellyfin.Api.Middleware;
using Jellyfin.Api.Networking;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Jellyfin.Api.Tests.Middleware;

public class IPBasedAccessValidationMiddlewareTests
{
    [Fact]
    public async Task Invoke_LogsWarningAndReturns503_WhenRemoteAccessIsNotAllowed()
    {
        // Arrange
        var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<IPBasedAccessValidationMiddleware>>();
        var networkManagerMock = new Mock<INetworkManager>();
        networkManagerMock.Setup(n => n.ShouldAllowServerAccess(It.IsAny<IPAddress>())).Returns(RemoteAccessPolicyResult.Deny);
        var httpContextMock = new Mock<HttpContext>();
        httpContextMock.Setup(c => c.IsLocal()).Returns(false);
        httpContextMock.Setup(c => c.GetNormalizedRemoteIP()).Returns(IPAddress.Parse("192.168.1.100"));
        httpContextMock.Setup(c => c.Request.Path).Returns("/test");

        var middleware = new IPBasedAccessValidationMiddleware(async (httpContext) => { }, loggerMock.Object);
        middleware._next = async (httpContext) => { };
        middleware._logger = loggerMock.Object;

        // Act
        await middleware.Invoke(httpContextMock.Object, networkManagerMock.Object).ConfigureAwait(false);

        // Assert
        loggerMock.Verify(l => l.LogWarning(It.IsAny<string>(), It.IsAny<object[]>()), Times.Once);
        httpContextMock.Verify(c => c.Response.StatusCode, Times.Once).Returns(StatusCodes.Status503ServiceUnavailable);
    }
}
